metadata.description: Cheapest sensible size. D2as_v7 = 2 vCPU / 8 GiB burstable. Step up to Standard_D2as_v5 when credits run dry.
Set true for Spot (roughly 60-80% cheaper, but Azure can evict you mid-raid).
Minutes with zero players before the VM tears itself down.
Grace period after boot before idle checks start (people need time to join).
Absolute ceiling on VM lifetime. Backstop in case the player count is unreadable.
Listing the server publicly is what makes the Steam query -- and therefore the player count -- work. Password still required to join.

Valheim world modifiers, passed through to the server command line.
Order matters: -preset is read first and overwrites anything before it, so put it first or omit it.
  resources    muchless | less | more | muchmore | most     (rounds UP; excludes fish, trophies, boss drops)
  portals      casual | hard | veryhard                      (casual = metals through portals)
  deathpenalty casual | veryeasy | easy | hard | hardcore
  combat       veryeasy | easy | hard | veryhard
  raids        none | muchless | less | more | muchmore
  setkeys      nobuildcost | playerevents | passivemobs | nomap
Add -crossplay for console players.
SSH public key. NSG does not expose 22; this is only a VM creation requirement. Use Run Command for admin.

variables.cloudInitRaw:
#cloud-config
# Tokens __LIKE_THIS__ are replaced by server.bicep.
package_update: true
packages: [jq, curl, ca-certificates, gnupg]

write_files:
  - path: /opt/valheim/env
    permissions: "0600"
    content: |
      STORAGE_ACCOUNT=__STORAGE_ACCOUNT__
      UAMI_CLIENT_ID=__UAMI_CLIENT_ID__
      RESOURCE_GROUP=__RESOURCE_GROUP__
      IDLE_MINUTES=__IDLE_MINUTES__
      MAX_UPTIME_MINUTES=__MAX_UPTIME_MINUTES__
      BOOT_GRACE_MINUTES=__BOOT_GRACE_MINUTES__
      LOCATION=__LOCATION__

  - path: /opt/valheim/docker-compose.yml
    content: |
      services:
        valheim:
          image: ghcr.io/lloesche/valheim-server
          container_name: valheim
          restart: unless-stopped
          stop_grace_period: 2m          # lets the server save on shutdown
          cap_add: [SYS_NICE]
          ports:
            - "2456-2457:2456-2457/udp"
            - "80:80/tcp"
          volumes:
            - /opt/valheim/config:/config
            - /opt/valheim/data:/opt/valheim
          environment:
            SERVER_NAME: "__SERVER_NAME__"
            WORLD_NAME: "__WORLD_NAME__"
            SERVER_PASS: "__SERVER_PASS__"
            SERVER_PUBLIC: "__SERVER_PUBLIC__"   # true = listed publicly, but also the ONLY way status.json reports players
            SERVER_ARGS: "__SERVER_ARGS__"       # world modifiers; -preset must come first if used
            STATUS_HTTP: "true"
            STATUS_HTTP_PORT: "80"
            RESTART_CRON: ""             # no nightly restart; we don't run long enough to need it
            UPDATE_CRON: ""              # steam update happens on boot anyway
            BACKUPS_INTERVAL: "1800"     # zipped backup every 30 min ...
            BACKUPS_MAX_AGE: "3"
            POST_BACKUP_HOOK: "/config/hooks/post-backup.sh @BACKUP_FILE@"   # ... pushed to blob
            TZ: "Europe/Oslo"

  - path: /opt/valheim/config/hooks/post-backup.sh
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      # Runs INSIDE the container after each backup; hands the file to the host uploader via a queue dir.
      cp "$1" /config/backup-queue/ 2>/dev/null || true

  - path: /opt/valheim/bin/azlogin.sh
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      . /opt/valheim/env
      az account show >/dev/null 2>&1 || az login --identity --client-id "$UAMI_CLIENT_ID" -o none

  - path: /opt/valheim/bin/restore.sh
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      # Pull the world from blob before the server starts. Recursive, so it
      # restores the 1.0 directory layout exactly as it was uploaded.
      set -uo pipefail
      . /opt/valheim/env
      /opt/valheim/bin/azlogin.sh || { echo "restore: az login FAILED" | systemd-cat -t valheim -p err; exit 0; }
      mkdir -p /opt/valheim/config/worlds_local
      az storage blob download-batch --auth-mode login --account-name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" \
        -s valheim --pattern 'worlds_local/*' -d /opt/valheim/config --overwrite -o none || true
      n=$(find /opt/valheim/config/worlds_local -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
      echo "restore: $n world files" | systemd-cat -t valheim
      [ "$n" -eq 0 ] && echo "restore: no saved world found, a new one will be generated" | systemd-cat -t valheim -p warning
      exit 0

  - path: /opt/valheim/bin/sync.sh
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      # Push the world to blob. Every 5 min, and at teardown.
      #
      # Valheim 1.0 stores a world as a DIRECTORY of generation-numbered files:
      #   _main.<N>.db2  _main.<N>.fwl2  _main.<N>.chunks  _main.<N>.ok
      #   plus coordinate-named terrain chunks (1e_20__1_1.chunk)
      # N increments on every save, so a plain upload would pile up every
      # generation forever and restore would mix stale chunks with current ones.
      # Strategy: upload everything first (blob is never missing a file), then
      # delete remote files that no longer exist locally. Blob versioning and
      # 30-day soft delete mean a wrong prune is recoverable from the portal.
      set -uo pipefail
      . /opt/valheim/env
      exec 9>/var/lock/valheim-sync.lock; flock 9
      /opt/valheim/bin/azlogin.sh || { echo "sync: az login FAILED" | systemd-cat -t valheim -p err; exit 1; }

      src=/opt/valheim/config/worlds_local
      if [ -z "$(ls -A "$src" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        echo "sync: worlds_local is empty, nothing to push" | systemd-cat -t valheim -p warning
        exit 0
      fi

      if ! az storage blob upload-batch --auth-mode login --account-name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" \
             -d valheim/worlds_local -s "$src" --overwrite -o none; then
        echo "sync: UPLOAD FAILED, keeping remote as-is" | systemd-cat -t valheim -p err
        exit 1
      fi

      # Prune stale generations. Only runs after a clean upload.
      local_list=$(cd "$src" && find . -type f -printf '%P\n' | sort)
      remote_list=$(az storage blob list --auth-mode login --account-name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" \
        -c valheim --prefix worlds_local/ --query "[].name" -o tsv \
        | sed 's|^worlds_local/||' | sort)
      pruned=0
      while IFS= read -r stale; do
        [ -z "$stale" ] && continue
        az storage blob delete --auth-mode login --account-name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" \
          -c valheim -n "worlds_local/$stale" -o none && pruned=$((pruned+1))
      done < <(comm -13 <(echo "$local_list") <(echo "$remote_list"))

      echo "sync: pushed $(echo "$local_list" | wc -l) files, pruned $pruned stale" | systemd-cat -t valheim

      shopt -s nullglob
      for f in /opt/valheim/config/backup-queue/*.zip; do
        # The container's own zip backups are empty on 1.0 (they still look for
        # the old flat .db/.fwl layout). Drop the useless ones.
        [ "$(stat -c%s "$f")" -lt 1024 ] && { rm -f "$f"; continue; }
        az storage blob upload --auth-mode login --account-name "$STORAGE_ACCOUNT" \
          -c valheim -n "backups/$(basename "$f")" -f "$f" --overwrite -o none && rm -f "$f"
      done

  - path: /opt/valheim/bin/idle-check.sh
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      # Every minute. Tears down only on CONFIRMED emptiness -- an unreadable
      # player count is treated as "someone might be playing", never as idle.
      # A hard uptime cap bounds the cost if the count is permanently broken.
      . /opt/valheim/env
      uptime_min=$(( $(cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime) / 60 ))
      f=/run/valheim-idle-minutes

      if [ "$uptime_min" -ge "${MAX_UPTIME_MINUTES:-360}" ]; then
        echo "max uptime ${uptime_min}m reached - tearing down" | systemd-cat -t valheim
        systemctl start valheim-teardown.service
        exit 0
      fi

      [ "$uptime_min" -lt "$BOOT_GRACE_MINUTES" ] && exit 0

      players=""
      body=$(curl -fs --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1/status.json || true)
      if [ -n "$body" ] && [ "$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.error // "null"')" = "null" ]; then
        players=$(echo "$body" | jq -r '.player_count // empty')
      fi

      if [ -z "$players" ]; then
        # status.json unusable (SERVER_PUBLIC=false, or Steam query not answering).
        # Fall back to counting connect/disconnect lines in the server log.
        joins=$(docker logs --since 24h valheim 2>&1 | grep -c 'Got connection SteamID')
        leaves=$(docker logs --since 24h valheim 2>&1 | grep -c 'Closing socket')
        players=$(( joins - leaves ))
        [ "$players" -lt 0 ] && players=0
        source=log
      else
        source=status.json
      fi

      echo "idle-check: players=$players via $source (up ${uptime_min}m)" | systemd-cat -t valheim

      if [ "${players:-1}" -gt 0 ]; then echo 0 > $f; exit 0; fi
      n=$(( $(cat $f 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 )); echo $n > $f
      if [ "$n" -ge "$IDLE_MINUTES" ]; then
        echo "empty for ${n}m - tearing down" | systemd-cat -t valheim
        systemctl start valheim-teardown.service
      fi

  - path: /opt/valheim/bin/teardown.sh
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      # Graceful end of session: stop server (saves), final sync, then delete every resource in the RG.
      set -uo pipefail
      . /opt/valheim/env
      exec 8>/var/lock/valheim-teardown.lock; flock -n 8 || exit 0
      echo "teardown: begin" | systemd-cat -t valheim
      systemctl stop valheim-sync.timer valheim-idle.timer
      docker compose -f /opt/valheim/docker-compose.yml stop -t 120 || true
      /opt/valheim/bin/sync.sh
      /opt/valheim/bin/azlogin.sh
      echo "teardown: deleting resources in $RESOURCE_GROUP" | systemd-cat -t valheim
      az deployment group create -g "$RESOURCE_GROUP" --mode Complete \
        --template-file /opt/valheim/empty.json --name "teardown-$(date +%s)" --no-wait -o none

  - path: /opt/valheim/empty.json
    content: |
      { "$schema": "https://schema.management.azure.com/schemas/2019-04-01/deploymentTemplate.json#",
        "contentVersion": "1.0.0.0", "resources": [] }

  - path: /etc/systemd/system/valheim.service
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Valheim server (docker compose)
      After=docker.service network-online.target
      Requires=docker.service
      [Service]
      Type=oneshot
      RemainAfterExit=yes
      WorkingDirectory=/opt/valheim
      ExecStartPre=/opt/valheim/bin/restore.sh
      ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker compose up -d
      ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker compose stop -t 120
      ExecStopPost=/opt/valheim/bin/sync.sh
      [Install]
      WantedBy=multi-user.target

  - path: /etc/systemd/system/valheim-sync.service
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Push Valheim world to blob
      [Service]
      Type=oneshot
      ExecStart=/opt/valheim/bin/sync.sh

  - path: /etc/systemd/system/valheim-sync.timer
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Sync world every 5 minutes
      [Timer]
      OnBootSec=10min
      OnUnitActiveSec=5min
      [Install]
      WantedBy=timers.target

  - path: /etc/systemd/system/valheim-idle.service
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Valheim idle check
      [Service]
      Type=oneshot
      ExecStart=/opt/valheim/bin/idle-check.sh

  - path: /etc/systemd/system/valheim-idle.timer
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Idle check every minute
      [Timer]
      OnBootSec=2min
      OnUnitActiveSec=1min
      [Install]
      WantedBy=timers.target

  - path: /etc/systemd/system/valheim-teardown.service
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=Valheim graceful teardown (save, sync, delete RG contents)
      [Service]
      Type=oneshot
      ExecStart=/opt/valheim/bin/teardown.sh

runcmd:
  - mkdir -p /opt/valheim/config/backup-queue /opt/valheim/config/worlds_local /opt/valheim/data
  - curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh
  - curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | bash
  - systemctl daemon-reload
  - systemctl enable --now valheim.service valheim-sync.timer valheim-idle.timer
variables.cloudInit: [replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(variables('cloudInitRaw'), '__STORAGE_ACCOUNT__', parameters('storageAccountName')), '__UAMI_CLIENT_ID__', parameters('vmIdentityClientId')), '__RESOURCE_GROUP__', resourceGroup().name), '__SERVER_NAME__', parameters('serverName')), '__WORLD_NAME__', parameters('worldName')), '__SERVER_PASS__', parameters('serverPassword')), '__IDLE_MINUTES__', string(parameters('idleMinutes'))), '__MAX_UPTIME_MINUTES__', string(parameters('maxUptimeMinutes'))), '__SERVER_PUBLIC__', toLower(string(parameters('serverPublic')))), '__SERVER_ARGS__', parameters('serverArgs')), '__BOOT_GRACE_MINUTES__', string(parameters('bootGraceMinutes'))), '__LOCATION__', parameters('location'))]
